caseStudies.title: Heat Extremes Assessment
caseStudies.description: Assessed Pakistan's 1990 to 2023 heat extremes using ETCCDI indices and remote sensing. Balochistan showed highest heat vulnerability, while pre-monsoon heatwaves dominated nationwide, supporting climate risk assessment, early warning, and resilience planning.

caseStudies.title: Environmental Assessment
caseStudies.description: Conducted an environmental assessment for a Sahiwal cattle feed facility against ISO 14001 EMS requirements, identifying operational impacts and recommending improvements in resource efficiency, waste management, pollution prevention, and regulatory compliance.

caseStudies.title: Drought Assessment
caseStudies.description: Assessed Southern Pakistan's 1990 to 2023 drought using meteorological and satellite data with SPI and RDI. The study area showed persistent mild to moderate drought and recurring heatwaves. The findings helped improve drought monitoring, water management, and climate adaptation.
